purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software — public health insurance claim point calculation and separation processing
purpose.summary: This program (ORCR0035) performs public-expense (公費) point separation and determination for medical insurance claims. It reads receipt intermediate files (RECE02, RECE04, RECE05), calculates public-expense separation indices, rewrites RECE04 records, and edits RECE05 records. It is part of the JMA ORCA open-source receipt billing system used by Japanese medical institutions.

notable_features: INDEXED file I/O with DYNAMIC access and START/READ NEXT
COPY with REPLACING for file parameter area reuse
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for shell invocation
CALL to MCP (MCPDATA/CPORCMCP) DB access layer
Japanese comments encoded in EUC-JP (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
PERFORM VARYING with complex UNTIL conditions
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP DB layer
verdict.notes: Source comments are in Japanese EUC-JP encoding, decoded here as latin-1 producing mojibake. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA receipt system. Source is truncated at 16000 chars (~55% of file); remaining code likely contains additional section logic. No COMP-3 usage detected despite financial calculations — points may be stored as display numerics.
